scope: All 66 rows handed from DB-004 to DB-007 for faculty/learner profile persistence
keyFindings: faculty.faculty_type is authorization-bearing and must not be flattened into faculty_profiles.employment_type.
faculty/learner legacy address alias is explicitly compatibility-only and is not used by current profile AddressDTO CRUD; retirement still needs approval.

Learner granular current/permanent city/state/pincode, coding profiles, privacy-safe identity, resume and one-time video-intro now have explicit staged DB04 targets; registration/API/runtime proof remains pending.
learner coding_profiles, resume_url, video_intro_url/video_intro_uploaded_at and privacy-safe identity persistence remain active DB04 target gaps.
Faculty identity/profile image already have a privacy-safe staged DB04 contract; raw identity secrets and arbitrary image URLs are deliberate redesigns.
